newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Peters to hold news conference on Morgan, ATN.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters to hold news conference on Morgan, ATN.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters will hold a news conference at 1.00 p.m. (0100 GMT) in Wellington on Thursday to discuss his New Zealand First party's MP Tukoroirangi Morgan and allegations about Morgan's financial relationship with Aotearoa Television Network, his office said.
A spokesman told Reuters the news conference would be "about Tuku Morgan and ATN".
Earlier today Peters, who leads NZ First in the coalition government, told Radio New Zealand he believed allegations of mispending against Morgan were false and the coalition was "rock solid".
